title: "[NAME REQUEST] "

---

Names in `data/arrests/` are withheld by owner policy. This form is the gate.
It is reviewed by a human. Filing it releases nothing.

**Which records?** (list `record_id`s from `data/arrests/records.csv`, or a
date window — e.g. `LC-20260905-001` … `LC-20260905-022`)

**Purpose** — must be public safety or non-discriminatory research. Describe
the specific question you are trying to answer:

**Who you are / who you act for** (organisation, role, and whether the work is
published):

**What you will do with the names**, and where they will be stored:

**Confirm each** — leave the bracket and write yes:

- [ ] I will not use these names to target, screen, rank, or profile any person
- [ ] I will not use them for employment, tenancy, credit, or insurance decisions
- [ ] I will not resell, republish, or feed them to a people-search service
- [ ] I will not use them to identify people by race, ethnicity, national
      origin, sex, gender, age, or immigration status
- [ ] I understand an arrest is a recommended charge at booking, not a finding
      of guilt, and I will say so wherever I use this data

> **Denied automatically:** requests with no stated purpose, requests that would
> identify or rank people by a protected characteristic, and any request whose
> aim is re-identification for its own sake.
>
> Note that the source article (Cap City News) is itself public and already
> names the people in these records. This gate governs what **this project**
> publishes and hands over — it is an access and use policy, not a claim that
> the names are secret. See `data/arrests/README.md` §Honesty.
